verdict.rationale: Workable documents a REST API (spi/v3), webhooks and an official MCP server, but the pack shows no official SDK or client library in any language. The ReadMe config flag "api_sdk_snippets":"enabled" only refers to generated code snippets in the docs, and an MCP server is a different capability, so neither counts as an SDK. Since a SaaS platform with a public API could plausibly ship SDKs, the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
